newsitem.title: GERMANY: Puma expects favourable Q4 after Q3 profit.
newsitem.headline: Puma expects favourable Q4 after Q3 profit.

text.p: German sportswear maker PUMA AG Rudolf Dassler Sport said on Wednesday it expected a favourable result in the fourth quarter of the year after increasing its profits in the first nine months of the year.

"The developments in the first nine months of the year, combined with the level of orders in hand as of September 30, lead us to expect further sales growth as well as positive profits for the fourth quarter," Puma said in a statement.

Puma said on Wednesday that operating profit in the third quarter rose 10.2 percent to 18.6 million marks from 16.9 million marks in the year-ago quarter while net sales rose 17 percent to 139.4 million marks from 120.2 million marks.
On a nine-month basis, Puma said operating profits rose four percent to 58.6 million marks from 56.5 million marks as sales surged 14 percent to 399.6 million marks from 350.1 million marks.

The sportswear maker, which has staged a dramatic recovery from the brink of bankruptcy, said its orders in hand as of September 30 rose 32 percent to 205.9 million marks compared with 155.9 million marks in the year-ago period.
